title: Smiling Woman in Fur Coat Holding Snowball, 1950s Winter Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a smiling woman standing amidst deep, freshly fallen snow during a heavy winter storm. She is warmly dressed in a mid-century style, wearing a thick, textured full-length fur coat over a sweater with a prominent white Peter Pan collar and slacks. She playfully holds out a snowball toward the camera. The back of the print features the faint handwritten caption asking 'How about a snowball?' along with an imprinted processing number '229'.
